verdict.rationale:
Docs show observability primitives — traces, sessions, tool calls, auth events, and failures reviewed post-run (metorial-docs-10), plus an 'Agents' area to inspect which clients connected and what they did (metorial-docs-35) and general activity logs (metorial-docs-33). But there's no evidence of aggregated usage analytics like call-volume dashboards, per-user breakdowns, or cost tracking for consumed/published servers and tools.

missing for 10: explicit call-volume metrics, per-user usage breakdowns, cost/billing analytics, and any published-server consumption analytics for external consumers.
